program.name: BS Computer Science
program.unit: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

courses.title: Computer Science I
searches: "CSC 150" sdstate "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI policy"
courses.note: No SDSU syllabus found; results were for Dakota State University, a different school.

courses.title: Computer Science II
searches: "CSC 250" sdstate "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI policy"
courses.note: No public syllabus found. CSC 300 Data Structures follows.

courses.title: Computer Organization and Architecture
searches: "CSC 317" sdstate "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI policy"
courses.note: The major requires no algorithms course (only CSC 300 Data Structures and CSC 445 Theory of Computation), so the required systems course is used; CSC 456 Operating Systems is also required. No public syllabus found.

courses.title: Foundations of Software Engineering
searches: "SE 305" sdstate "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI policy"
courses.note: SE 306 Software Project Management and Testing is also required. No public syllabus found.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
searches: South Dakota State University CSC artificial intelligence OR "machine learning" course catalog
"CSC 447" South Dakota State University artificial intelligence syllabus 2025
courses.note: Elective, not required by the BS in Computer Science core. CSC 447 is the mandatory course of the department's Artificial Intelligence focus area; Introduction to Machine Learning is a separate elective in that focus area. No syllabus found.

courses.title: Operating Systems
searches: South Dakota State University "CSC 456" operating systems syllabus
courses.note: Required: CSC 456 Operating Systems is in the major's required list and C3 is CSC 317. No syllabus found.

notes: Requirements checked against the 2025-26 sample plan (https://www.sdstate.edu/sites/default/files/file-archive/2025-05/Computer%20Science%20(BS)%202025-2026%20Sample%20Plan.pdf); the catalog program page returned no text to the fetch tool, and the 2016-17 catalog page for the same degree lists the same core. SDSU Policy 2:3 asks faculty to include a generative AI statement in each syllabus, but no frame-course syllabus was public. All four syllabi are not-found; search results were dominated by Dakota State University and South Dakota Mines.
